items.detail: Accommodation open for bookings before 1 April 2027 must be registered with the Welsh Revenue Authority (WRA) by 31 March 2027. Registration is free and mandatory across Wales, even where the local council has no visitor levy.
items.detail_zh: 2027 年 4 月 1 日前已开放预订的住宿，必须在 2027 年 3 月 31 日前向 Welsh Revenue Authority（WRA）注册。注册免费且全威尔士强制，即使当地议会不征收访客税也必须注册。
items.source_name: GOV.WALES (WRA) — Failing to register, update details, or deregister your visitor accommodation
items.title: Visitor accommodation registration deadline

items.detail: The WRA registration service opened on 1 October 2026. At launch it accepts new registrations only; updates to existing registrations were to open in early 2027, with changes to be updated by 31 March 2027.
items.detail_zh: WRA 注册服务于 2026 年 10 月 1 日开放。开放初期仅受理新注册；信息更新功能计划于 2027 年初开放，变更须在 2027 年 3 月 31 日前更新。
items.source_name: directbook.uk — Wales Holiday Let Registration (checked 21 Oct 2026)
items.title: Registration service opening date

items.detail: You must register if all apply: you take bookings for overnight stays in visitor accommodation in Wales; you are responsible for the accommodation (own, rent, or act for the owner); and your bookings are for 31 nights or less. Covers self-catering lets, main homes/spare rooms, hotels, B&Bs, guesthouses, tent/caravan/motorhome pitches, glamping, static caravans, hostels and bunkhouses.
items.detail_zh: 同时满足以下三项即须注册：在威尔士提供过夜住宿预订；对住宿负责（自有、租赁或代业主）；预订为 31 晚或更短。涵盖自助式度假屋、主居/空房、酒店、B&B、民宿、帐篷/房车营位、豪华露营、固定房车、青年旅舍和集体宿舍。
items.source_name: GOV.WALES (WRA) — Registering visitor accommodation: overview (updated 8 Oct 2026)
items.title: Who must register (31-night test)

items.detail: The register is run by the Welsh Revenue Authority under the Visitor Accommodation (Register and Levy) Etc. (Wales) Act 2025 (Royal Assent 18 September 2025). After registering you receive a unique registration number; some details appear on a public register.
items.detail_zh: 注册由 Welsh Revenue Authority 依据《2025 年访客住宿（注册与征税）等（威尔士）法》（2025 年 9 月 18 日获御准）管理。注册后获得唯一注册号，部分信息会公开在公共登记册上。
items.title: Registration administrator and registration number

items.detail: Accommodation first offered for bookings on or after 1 April 2027 must be registered before it opens for bookings. Updates to registration details and deregistration must be made within 30 days of the change.
items.detail_zh: 2027 年 4 月 1 日及之后才开放预订的住宿，必须在开放预订前完成注册。注册信息变更与注销须在变更发生后 30 天内完成。
items.source_name: GOV.WALES (WRA) — Failing to register, update details, or deregister your visitor accommodation
items.title: New accommodation opening after 1 April 2027
items.value: Must register before opening for bookings

items.detail: The penalty for failing to register, update, or deregister on time is £100 per premises (each address offered as accommodation counts as one premises). Penalties are payable within 30 days. Known conclusion (£100 late fine) confirmed against the official GOV.WALES penalties page.
items.detail_zh: 未按时注册、更新或注销的罚款为每处物业 £100（每个提供住宿的地址计为一处）。罚款须在 30 天内缴纳。已知结论（迟到罚款 £100）已对照 gov.wales 官方罚款页证实。
items.source_name: GOV.WALES (WRA) — Failing to register, update details, or deregister your visitor accommodation
items.title: Late registration penalty

items.detail: If you still do not register, update or deregister after the first penalty, a further £10 per premises per day applies for up to 30 days; failing to register within those 30 days brings a further £1,000 penalty per premises. Maximum per premises: £1,400 (£100 + £300 + £1,000). The WRA may also register you itself; that counts as a late registration with the same penalties.
items.detail_zh: 首次罚款后仍未注册/更新/注销的，每处物业每天追加 £10，最长 30 天；30 天内仍未注册的，每处再罚 £1,000。每处最高合计 £1,400（£100 + £300 + £1,000）。WRA 也有权代为注册，视同迟到注册，罚款相同。
items.source_name: GOV.WALES (WRA) — Failing to register, update details, or deregister your visitor accommodation
items.title: Escalating penalties for continued failure to register
items.value: £10 per premises per day for up to 30 days, then a further £1,000 per premises

items.detail: Rates are set Wales-wide by the Welsh Government: 75p per person per night for adults in shared rooms in hostels, bunkhouses, bothies or dormitories and for tent pitches; £1.30 per person per night for all other accommodation (including self-catering lets, hotels and B&Bs). Under-18s are exempt on the lower rate only; stays of 32 nights or more in one booking pay no levy. Known conclusion (£1.30 / 75p) confirmed against the official GOV.WALES release.
items.detail_zh: 税率由威尔士政府全威尔士统一设定：青年旅舍/集体宿舍/多人间合住房间及帐篷营位为每人每晚 75p（成年人）；其他所有住宿（含自助式度假屋、酒店、B&B）为每人每晚 £1.30。18 岁以下仅在低税率住宿免税；单次预订 32 晚及以上不征税。已知结论（£1.30/75p）已对照 gov.wales 官方发布证实。
items.source_name: GOV.WALES — Senedd passes legislation to support the future of tourism in Wales
items.title: Visitor levy rates
items.value: £1.30 per person per night (standard); 75p per person per night (hostels, bunkhouses, dormitories, tent pitches)

items.detail: The levy is not national: each council decides whether to introduce it after consulting its community, with 12 months' notice required; a levy takes effect on 1 April or 1 October. Cardiff is the first and, as of late October 2026, the only council charging it: its levy applies to stays from 1 April 2027, with accounting on new bookings from 28 September 2026. Isle of Anglesey decided on 24 September 2026 not to introduce a levy at present; Conwy deferred a decision the same day.
items.detail_zh: 访客税不是全国统一征收：22 个威尔士议会各自决定是否征收，须先咨询社区并提前 12 个月通知；征税从 4 月 1 日或 10 月 1 日起生效。卡迪夫是首个、截至 2026 年 10 月下旬唯一征收的议会：适用于 2027 年 4 月 1 日起的住宿，自 2026 年 9 月 28 日起的新预订开始记账。安格尔西岛于 2026 年 9 月 24 日决定暂不征收；康威同日推迟决定。
items.source_name: GOV.WALES — Senedd passes legislation to support the future of tourism in Wales
items.title: Visitor levy is council-by-council, earliest 1 April 2027
items.value: Each of the 22 Welsh councils decides; earliest start 1 April 2027

items.detail: The Act creates the legal framework for a licensing scheme for visitor accommodation in Wales, starting with self-contained self-catering accommodation (holiday cottages and flats), and builds on the 2025 Act register. It also creates a Code of Welsh law on tourism. No licence is needed yet and no application exists.
items.detail_zh: 该法为威尔士访客住宿牌照制度创设法律框架，从独立式自助住宿（度假小屋与公寓）开始，并以 2025 年法案的注册制度为基础；同时创设威尔士旅游法典。目前尚不需要牌照，也没有申请通道。
items.source_name: GOV.WALES — Licensing of visitor accommodation in Wales (updated 8 May 2026)
items.title: Licensing Act: Royal Assent and scope
items.value: Development of Tourism and Regulation of Visitor Accommodation (Wales) Act 2026; Royal Assent 27 April 2026

items.detail: The Welsh Government has said the licensing scheme is 'likely to start in 2029'. This is a stated expectation, not a date fixed in the Act. Licence standards are expected to include gas and electrical safety certificates, carbon monoxide alarms, public liability insurance, and a fire safety risk assessment with relevant precautions. Known conclusion (2029 plan) confirmed as a government expectation; it is not the statutory default.
items.detail_zh: 威尔士政府表示牌照制度“可能于 2029 年启动”。这是政府预期表述，不是法案规定的日期。牌照标准预计包括燃气与电气安全证书、一氧化碳报警器、公众责任险以及消防风险评估及相关预防措施。已知结论（2029 年计划）证实为政府预期，非定法定期限。
items.source_name: Welsh Government News — Wales to create new standards for holiday accommodation (17 Mar 2026)
items.title: Licensing scheme likely to start in 2029 (government expectation, not a statutory date)

items.detail: GOV.WALES states the legal default is that the licensing scheme will come into force in March 2030; before that there will be further consultation on the regulations and guidance will be published. Under s.61 of the 2026 Act the default date is 4 March 2030, and Welsh Ministers can bring the scheme in earlier or move the date back by up to 2 years. Known conclusion (March 2030 statutory default) confirmed against the official GOV.WALES licensing page.
items.detail_zh: gov.wales 称牌照制度的法定默认生效时间为 2030 年 3 月；此前将就法规进一步咨询并发布指南。根据 2026 年法案第 61 条，默认日期为 2030 年 3 月 4 日，威尔士大臣可提前实施或最多推迟 2 年。已知结论（2030 年 3 月法定默认）已对照 gov.wales 官方牌照页证实。
items.source_name: GOV.WALES — Licensing of visitor accommodation in Wales (updated 8 May 2026)
items.title: Licensing legal default start: March 2030
items.value: March 2030 (4 March 2030 per s.61 of the 2026 Act)

items.detail: 未公开/待核实：截至 2026-11-16，未见官方公布的牌照费金额。首次收费法规须先经过至少 12 周咨询。媒体报道中出现的约 £75（大臣口头表述）与 £172/年（法案影响评估口径）等数字相互矛盾且非官方定价，本文件不予采纳。
items.detail_zh: 未公开/待核实：截至 2026-11-16，未见官方公布的牌照费金额。首次收费法规须先经过至少 12 周咨询。媒体报道中出现的约 £75（大臣口头表述）与 £172/年（法案影响评估口径）等数字相互矛盾且非官方定价，本文件不予采纳。
items.source_name: UK Short-Let Rules Tracker — Wales Holiday Let Licensing Law (2026 Act), checked 31 Oct 2026
items.title: Licensing fee

items.detail: Since the 2022 amendments (Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) (Amendment) (Wales) Order 2022, in force autumn 2022), Wales has three dwellinghouse use classes: C3 — dwellinghouse used as a sole or main residence, occupied more than 183 days in a calendar year; C5 — dwellinghouse used otherwise than as a sole or main residence, occupied 183 days or fewer; C6 — dwellinghouse commercially let for short terms not exceeding 31 days. Before the change, all three uses fell within C3.
items.detail_zh: 自 2022 年修订（《城乡规划（用途分类）（修订）（威尔士）令 2022》，2022 年秋季生效）起，威尔士住宅分三类：C3——唯一或主要居所，每年居住超过 183 天；C5——非唯一/主要居所，每年居住 183 天或更少；C6——商业短租，每次租期不超过 31 天。修订前三类用途均属 C3。
items.source_name: High Court judgment [2025] EWHC 437 (Admin), R (Williams) v Cyngor Gwynedd, para 3 (27 Feb 2025)
items.title: Planning use classes C3 / C5 / C6 (Wales only)
items.value: C3 main residence; C5 second home; C6 short-term let

items.detail: As a general rule, changing use between C3, C5 and C6 (and mixed uses) is permitted development and needs no planning permission, unless the local planning authority has made an Article 4 direction removing that right — which requires local evidence of impact. Whether a change of use is a material change of use is a question of fact and degree in each case; non-material changes need no permission regardless. Gwynedd's Article 4 direction (operational 1 Sep 2024) was quashed by the High Court on 24 September 2025 ([2025] EWHC 2395 (Admin)); Eryri (Snowdonia) National Park Authority has an active Article 4 direction.
items.detail_zh: 一般规则下，C3/C5/C6 之间（及混合用途）的用途转换属于许可开发，无需规划许可，除非地方规划当局已作出 Article 4 指令取消该权利——指令须有本地影响证据支撑。用途变更是否构成“实质性变更”按个案事实与程度判断；非实质性变更无论如何都不需要许可。格温内斯的 Article 4 指令（2024 年 9 月 1 日生效）已于 2025 年 9 月 24 日被高等法院撤销（[2025] EWHC 2395 (Admin)）；厄里（斯诺登尼亚）国家公园管理局仍有生效的 Article 4 指令。
items.source_name: High Court judgment [2025] EWHC 2395 (Admin), R (Williams) v Cyngor Gwynedd (24 Sep 2025)
items.title: C3 to C6 change of use and Article 4 directions
items.value: Permitted development between C3/C5/C6 unless an Article 4 direction removes the right

items.detail: A self-catering property in Wales is non-domestic (liable for business rates, not council tax) only if the Valuation Office is satisfied that: it will be available for commercial letting for short periods totalling 252 days or more in the following 12 months; it was available for at least 252 days in the previous 12 months; and it was actually commercially let for at least 182 days in that period. 'Short periods' means lets of 28 days or fewer. Thresholds at current levels since 1 April 2023 (previously 140/70). Missing either test makes the property domestic and liable for council tax.
items.detail_zh: 威尔士自助式度假屋仅在满足以下条件时才属非住宅（缴营业税而非市政税）：未来 12 个月可商业出租短租期合计 252 天或以上；过去 12 个月可出租 252 天或以上；且同一时期实际商业出租至少 182 天。“短租期”指 28 天或更短的租期。现行阈值自 2023 年 4 月 1 日起生效（此前为 140/70 天）。任一测试不达标即按住宅缴市政税。
items.source_name: Business Wales (Welsh Government) — Non-Domestic Rates for Self-Catering Properties in Wales
items.title: Self-catering business rates tests: 252 days available, 182 days let
items.value: Available ≥252 days and actually let ≥182 days in the previous 12 months

items.detail: From 1 April 2026 (Non-Domestic Rating (Amendment of Definition of Domestic Property) (Wales) Order 2026, WSI 2026 No. 7), if the 182-day test is not met in the most recent 12 months, an average of days actually let over the previous two or three 12-month periods of at least 182 days may satisfy it. Up to 14 days per year of free short breaks donated through a registered charity may also count towards the letting criteria.
items.detail_zh: 自 2026 年 4 月 1 日起（《2026 年非住宅税率（住宅定义修订）（威尔士）令》，WSI 2026 No. 7），如最近 12 个月未达 182 天实际出租，前两个或前三个 12 个月期间实际出租天数的平均值达到 182 天也可满足测试。通过注册慈善机构免费捐赠的短期住宿每年最多 14 天也可计入出租天数。
items.source_name: Business Wales (Welsh Government) — Non-Domestic Rates for Self-Catering Properties in Wales
items.title: 182-day test: multi-year averaging and charitable allowance (from 1 April 2026)
items.value: Average over the previous 2 or 3 years may satisfy the 182-day test; up to 14 charitable days per year count

items.detail: The Welsh Government consulted (31 July – 23 October 2026) on changes to the letting criteria for classifying self-catering properties, including reviewing the 182-day threshold and five proposed exemptions for properties that could not be used as permanent homes. Any change would need legislation and was intended to take effect on 1 April 2027. As of 2026-11-16 no government response had been published; the 252/182-day tests remain in force. Proposed figures floated in consultation (e.g. 105 days, 154 days) are not law.
items.detail_zh: 威尔士政府于 2026 年 7 月 31 日至 10 月 23 日就自助式物业分类的出租标准进行咨询，包括复核 182 天阈值及五项拟议豁免（针对无法作永久住宅的物业）。任何变更须立法，原计划 2027 年 4 月 1 日生效。截至 2026-11-16 尚未公布政府回应；252/182 天测试继续有效。咨询中出现的数字（如 105 天、154 天）不是法律。
items.source_name: GOV.WALES — Written Statement: Consultation on the classification of self-catering properties for local tax purposes (31 July 2026)
items.title: Consultation on the 182-day threshold (closed 23 October 2026, outcome awaited)
items.value: Consultation ran 31 July – 23 October 2026; outcome not yet published as of 2026-11-16

items.detail: Since 1 April 2023 the maximum level at which Welsh local authorities can set a council tax premium on second homes is 300% on top of the standard bill. A self-catering property that fails the 252/182-day tests falls back to council tax and may face this premium.
items.detail_zh: 自 2023 年 4 月 1 日起，威尔士地方议会对第二套住房的市政税附加费上限为标准账单的 300%。未通过 252/182 天测试的自助式度假屋将改缴市政税，并可能面临该附加费。
items.source_name: UK Holiday Let Software Directory — Wales: the 182-day letting rule (citing GOV.WALES, Council Tax on empty and second homes, updated 9 Mar 2023)
items.title: Council tax premium on second homes (up to 300%)
items.value: Local authorities may set a second-home council tax premium of up to 300%
